title: Nobel Prize Explainer (2023–2026)
description: Every Nobel Prize from 2023–2026 explained in plain English: a filterable gallery of all six categories across four years, each with its own interactive exhibit — attosecond pulse builders, quantum tunneling, immune-system peacekeepers, creative-destruction economies, and more.

title: Tabby Slink
description: A brown mackerel tabby on a low nocturnal stalk: planted paws, a hovering step, tail-tip freezes, and a coat of broken stripes in moonlight.

title: Interactive Particle Vector Field
description: Real-time canvas flow field with simplex noise, velocity vectors, cursor gravitational attraction, and customizable palettes.

title: Sorting Algorithm Visualizer
description: Step-by-step visualizer comparing Tim Sort, Quicksort, Mergesort, Heapsort, Shell Sort, Radix Sort (LSD), Bubble, and Selection sort with real-time metrics.

title: Cellular Automata Lab
description: Conway's Game of Life, Brian's Brain, and HighLife simulators with interactive brush drawing, preset oscillators, and spaceship launchers.

title: Lower Leg Circulation & DVT Visualizer
description: Explore how heel raises, ankle motion, walking, and rest drive the calf-muscle pump and its one-way vein valves, with an educational DVT concept view.
